caveats: The model plays practice boards only while a stage quest holds him (balance.json model.practice): its days per 回 run long.

The model plays no 杂役 errands and no 开府: 灵石 earned is low, affordability pessimistic. It takes a share of the day's wall tags (balance.json `walls`), the rest while a gate holds him (a gate's wait counts them).
A 回 holds him on its stage quest's layer (else its cap); a 今 interlude takes the 古 before it.
A day of sitting = one night of 闭关 (rewards.json seclusion rest_hours) at the layer, as the rules pay it.
